title: AI 改寫更易閱讀，也能快速找到更多指令
summary: 統一原文與結果排版，提供可調整的對照比例與差異閱讀；緊湊指令清單支援固定、最近與跨分類搜尋。
highlights: 原文與結果對齊，拖曳分隔線即可調整並保存閱讀比例。
指令改為緊湊清單，數量增加後可切換全部、固定與最近，搜尋跨所有指令。
可切換差異標示與完整閱讀，複製與替換仍保留原始結果。
usage: 開啟 AI 改寫，選擇指令或輸入要求；完成後可切換顯示差異。兩份文字各不超過 12,000 字元時提供差異模式，大幅變動可能整段標示。使用前請先設定 AI 服務、模型與所需金鑰。

en.title: Read AI rewrites clearly and find more commands
en.summary: Aligned text, adjustable comparison panes, optional change highlighting, and a compact command list with pinned, recent, and global search views.
highlights: Original and result text align, with draggable dividers that save reading proportions.
A compact command list adds All, Pinned, and Recent views for larger collections, with search across all commands.
Switch between change highlighting and clean reading while copying and replacement preserve the raw result.
en.usage: Open AI Rewrite and choose a command or enter an instruction. Select Show changes after completion. Highlighting supports texts up to 12,000 characters each; large edits may be marked as whole regions. Configure your AI endpoint, model, and required key first.
